title: John Glenn urged Harry Reid to investigate UFOs

tellings.quote: Glenn who urged Harry Reid to investigate UFOs as part of Asa

plain: The astronaut and senator John Glenn is said to have urged Harry Reid, a powerful senator from Nevada, to look into UFOs, which fed into a government UFO study. Michels mentions this himself in passing in a documentary episode about a former Pentagon official, without naming a source or giving a date.
